sql.if: and (d.creator_id=#{userId}exists(select 1 from sys_user cu where cu.user_id=d.creator_id and cu.dept_id=#{deptId} and cu.del_flag='0'))

mapper.select: select coalesce((select sum(p.total_cents) from purchase_orders p join documents d on d.id=p.document_id where d.type='PURCHASE_ORDER' and d.approval_status='APPROVED' and d.deleted='0' ),0) valid_order_cents, coalesce((select sum(i.total_cents) from invoices i join documents d on d.id=i.document_id where d.type='INVOICE' and d.approval_status='APPROVED' and d.deleted='0' ),0) approved_invoice_cents, coalesce((select sum(i.total_cents) from invoices i join documents d on d.id=i.document_id where d.type='INVOICE' and d.approval_status='IN_REVIEW' and d.deleted='0' ),0) pending_invoice_cents, (select count(1) from receipts r join documents d on d.id=r.document_id where d.deleted='0' ) receipt_count, (select count(1) from workflow_tasks where assignee_id=#{userId} and status='PENDING') pending_task_count
